episodes.title: Slightly Foxed - Part One
episodes.summary: There's a new assistant to train up at Book's Books, but the excavation of a nearby bombsite that's full of skeletons leads to book-selling taking a back seat.

episodes.title: Slightly Foxed - Part Two
episodes.summary: Bliss and Book's investigation into Harkup's death continues as Book discovers some surprising evidence in the case of the bombsite skeletons.

episodes.title: Deadly Nitrate - Part One
episodes.summary: There's excitement in the air when a film crew arrives at Archangel Lane - until an extra drops dead after eating poisoned chocolates meant for one of the cast.

episodes.title: Deadly Nitrate - Part Two
episodes.summary: Book must race against time to uncover the truth before anyone else ends up dead. Meanwhile, Jack gets an unexpected answer when he confronts Trottie and Book.

episodes.title: Such Devoted Sisters - Part One
episodes.summary: When an army captain drinks a poisoned cocktail, there are multiple suspects - even Trottie! But two exiled princesses believe he wasn't the intended victim.

episodes.title: Such Devoted Sisters - Part Two
episodes.summary: As tension builds, the staff at the Walsingham Hotel rebel. Meanwhile, Book discovers something quite curious in Captain Victor Orr's little black book.

episodes.title: Memento Mori - Part One
episodes.summary: When a charismatic medium hosts a mysterious seance, a table full of suspects are under investigation as Book reunites with Inspector Bliss to solve the mystery.

episodes.title: Memento Mori - Part Two
episodes.summary: The evidence forces Book and the team to face a disturbing question: has a notorious fascist who ended up on the gallows returned from the grave to kill again?

episodes.title: Dead Man's Whistle - Part One
episodes.summary: Inspector Bliss and Book are unconvinced when a body is found in unusual circumstances in a tailor's shop and the elderly proprietor is keen to confess.

episodes.title: Dead Man's Whistle - Part Two
episodes.summary: As Jack's good fortune runs out, Book and the team decipher the handiwork of a tailor who is capable of much more than a stylish new suit.

episodes.title: Killer Nacht - Part One
episodes.summary: On a mission to stop a notorious book thief - the elusive Duchess Alberta - Book and Jack journey across post-war Germany to the town of Wurl.

episodes.title: Killer Nacht - Part Two
episodes.summary: With Book and Jack caught in the jaws of a deadly legacy in Germany, Inspector Bliss and local officer Liesl Pohl cross-examine the guests of the Schloss Von Bode.
